subject: Initial namespace & keying ops manifest — GreenBridge org entry
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@greenbridge.health>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenbridge.health
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff — GreenBridge initial org entry and keys

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the demo last week. We received executive approval to start a pilot — procurement looped me in to get contract steps started. Before legal signs off, I want to confirm the exact onboarding steps so our infra team can prepare. High-level needs:

- A dedicated project/namespace for GreenBridge (isolated billing and logs)
- Initial set of API keys (one service account + two user keys) with configurable expiry
- Role matrix (admin, developer, reader) and a suggested invite cadence for staff
- KMS integration notes — we expect to bring our own keys (BYOK) later this quarter

Can you send a short runbook and a proposed timeline? We prefer a one-week window for provisioning once the order is approved.

Attached: draft PO (procurement@).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Sara
Head of AI Integrations
GreenBridge Health
[Attachment: GB-draft-PO.pdf (pdf)]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@greenbridge.health>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — GreenBridge initial org entry and keys

Sara — great to hear. Summary and proposed next steps below (high level). I copied Monica (CS lead) and Dev (implementation eng) to scope the technical bits.

Proposed short-runbook (1-week provisioning target):
1) Contract signed -> Procurement sends PO and billing contact (Day 0)
2) Redwood creates GreenBridge project namespace (isolated billing + logs) (Day 1)
3) Seed two user API keys and one service account key; service account limited to model inference and upload scopes (Day 1)
4) Invite 3 initial users (admin, dev lead, security contact) with RBAC defaults; provide invite cadence for expansion (Day 2)
5) Provide API-key rotation guidance and automated expiry policy (we recommend 90d default) (Day 2)
6) KMS/BYOK intake checklist and options (Day 3)

Immediate asks for you: confirm billing contact and short list of initial users (name + email + role). If procurement can send PO to contracts@redwood.ai we’ll start Day 1 provisioning as soon as we receive it.

I’ll follow up with the technical runbook and a checklist attachment.

— Dylan
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, Sara Klein <sara.klein@greenbridge.health>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Oct 2028 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — GreenBridge initial org entry and keys

Adding the implementation checklist and decisions we usually make during the initial tenant handshake. I uploaded a slimmed-down checklist to the Drive link (see related_links). Key items below — please review and confirm:

Technical decisions we need from GreenBridge:
- Namespace name policy: prefer "greenbridge-prod" for production, "greenbridge-dev" for staging. Confirm if you want org-level prefixing.
- API key model: 1 service key (machine-to-machine) + 2 rotating user keys. Service key will be tied to a service account with a dedicated project quota.
- RBAC roles mapping: admin -> full, developer -> model/invoke + logs, reader -> read-only metrics. We recommend limiting token creation to admins only in prod.
- Invite cadence: initial: 3 invites (Day 1), expansion wave 1: up to 10 users (Day 4), wave 2: full team (post-canary).
- Canary plan: enable only 10% of calls routed to prod model variants during first week to monitor cost and performance.

Attachments I’m sending: a one-page seed checklist and the API key lifecycle guidance.

Action items for GreenBridge: share initial user list and billing contact so we can seed keys.

Monica
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: greenbridge-onboard-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, Sara Klein <sara.klein@greenbridge.health>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Oct 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — GreenBridge initial org entry and keys

Technical runbook (condensed) — items I will action once we have PO + user list:

1) Project & namespace creation:
   - Create project id: greenbridge-prod-94872, enable per-project logging and token-level billing export.

2) API key seeding:
   - Create service account: sb-greenbridge-inference@redwood-infra (scoped: inference.invoke, files.upload)
   - Mint service key (PKCS8) with expiration metadata (default 90d) and store encrypted in customer vault; send download link to security contact.
   - Create two user API keys: one admin-key (rotating) and one dev-key (non-admin) with 30d rotation enforced.

3) Role mapping and invites:
   - Create roles: GB_Admin, GB_Developer, GB_Reader.
   - Invite users via our invite flow; admin invites require SAML/SSO binding to GreenBridge once SSO is configured.

4) BYOK/KMS intake:
   - If GreenBridge wants BYOK, we’ll accept public key material and register the key alias in our HSM connector. Planned lead time: 3–5 business days after provisioning.

5) Security notes:
   - Recommend service keys use a short TTL and be rotated by our automation; user keys should be tied to individual accounts, not shared mailboxes.

Attachments: api-keying-guide.md (text) — includes curl examples, rotation endpoint, and sample policy rules.

Planned timeline assuming PO arrives by EOD Oct 10:
   - Oct 11: Namespace & seeding (Day 1)
   - Oct 12: Invites + API docs deliverable (Day 2)
   - Oct 14: BYOK intake & handoff if requested (Day 4)

Dev
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: api-keying-guide.md (text)]
